Theatre SPACEs is an Erasmus Mundus master in theatre for social, participatory, community and educational contexts, and its admission round closes on 1 December 2026 at 23:59 CET. It is one of the few funded European master programmes dedicated entirely to applied and community theatre practice.

Programme Highlights

  • Applied theatre specialisation spanning social, community and educational settings
  • Early deadline of 1 December 2026 (23:59 CET) for the next intake
  • Multi-country mobility with practice-based workshops and field placements
  • Graduates work in community arts, education, cultural policy and social projects

Who Should Apply

Applicants typically come from theatre, performing arts, education, social work and community development backgrounds; practical experience in facilitation or performance strengthens the file.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students: participation costs plus monthly allowance and travel support.

Deadline and How to Apply

Submit through the Theatre SPACEs admission page before the end of November and prepare audition/portfolio materials as specified in the call. Key deadline information: 1 December 2026 (23:59 CET).
